items.title: Volunteer Guide
items.lead: Everything a first-time volunteer needs to know before joining an event.

blocks.heading: What to Bring
paragraphs: Wear closed-toe shoes, bring a reusable water bottle, and dress for changing weather.
For cleanup and restoration days, we recommend long pants and work gloves if you have them.

cards.title: Trail Cleanup
cards.summary: Litter pickup and light trimming to keep walkways accessible.

cards.title: Habitat Support
cards.summary: Planting native species and removing invasive growth in priority zones.

cards.title: Event Support
cards.summary: Set-up, check-in, and wayfinding assistance at community gatherings.

blocks.heading: Ready to Join?
blocks.body: Sign up for the next volunteer day and we will send details.
